column3: dhyāyināṃ viṣayaḥ ko.sau kathaṃ yānatrayaṃ bhavet ||

nirbhidyettribhavaṃ ko.sau kiṃ sthānaṃ kā tanurbhavet |
sthitaḥ pravartate kutra jinaputraḥ kathaṃ bhavet ||
samādhyate kathaṃ cittaṃ brūhi me jinapuṃgava ||
lakṣaṇasya vyavasthānaṃ nairātmyaṃ ca kathaṃ bhavet ||
kathaṃ na vidyate sattvaḥ saṃvṛtyā deśanā katham |
kathaṃ hi tīrthikāstvaṃ ca lakṣaṇairna virudhyase |
śūnyatā ca kathaṃ kena kṣaṇabhaṅgaśca te katham |
kathaṃ pravartate garbhaḥ kathaṃ loko nirīhikaḥ ||
kathaṃ ca budhyase lokaṃ kathaṃ brūṣe nirakṣaram ||
nairātmyaṃ ca dvidhā kena kathaṃ jñeyaṃ viśudhyati ||
jñānaṃ katividhaṃ nātha śīlaṃ sattvākarāṇi ca |
kathaṃ yuktiḥ katividhā vyākhyānaṃ ca kathaṃvidham ||
annapānaṃ ca vaicitryaṃ maithunaṃ jāyate katham |
rājā ca cakravartī ca maṇḍalī ca kathaṃ bhavet ||
vidyāsthānaṃ bhavetkiṃ ca mokṣo yogī katividhaḥ |
prajñaptimātraṃ ca kathaṃ brūhi me vadatāṃ vara ||
ghanāḥ khe pavanaṃ kena smṛtirmeghaḥ kathaṃ bhavet |
taruvallyaḥ kathaṃ kena brūhi me tribhaveśvara ||
hayā gajā mṛgāḥ kena grahaṇaṃ yānti bāliśāḥ |
uhoḍimā narāḥ kena brūhi me cittasārathe ||
strīpuṃnapuṃsakānāṃ ca kathaṃ janma vadāhi me ||
kathaṃ caivaṃvidhā yoge narāḥ sthāpyā vadāhi me ||
gatyāgatānāṃ sattvānāṃ kiṃ liṅgaṃ kiṃ ca lakṣaṇam |
dhaneśvaraḥ kathaṃ kena brūhi me gaganopama ||
abhakṣyaṃ hi kathaṃ māṃsaṃ kathaṃ māṃsaṃ niṣidhyate |
sarvaratnamayāḥ kṣetrāḥ kathaṃ kena vadāhi me ||
kena nirmāṇikā buddhāḥ kena buddhā vipākajāḥ |
tathatā jñānabuddhā vai kathaṃ kena vadāhi me ||
kāmadhātau kathaṃ kena na vibuddho vadāhi me |
vinayo bhikṣubhāvaśca kathaṃ kena vadāhi me ||
cittaṃ hi bhūmayaḥ sapta kathaṃ kena vadāhi me ||
cikitsāśāstraṃ sattvānāṃ kathaṃ kena vadāhi me ||
idaṃ śrutvā mahāvīro buddho lokavidāṃ varaḥ |
nirodhā ṛddhipādāśca bodhyaṅgā mārga eva ca |
svabhāvaḥ kalpanā kalpyaṃ dṛśyaṃ dṛṣṭidvayaṃ katham |
jñānaṃ jñeyo gamaṃ prāptiḥ sattvānāṃ ca bhavābhavam ||
hayā gajā mṛgāḥ kena grahaṇaṃ brūhi me katham |
kāryaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ kena nānābhrāntistathā nayam |
cittamātraṃ na dṛśyo.sti bhūmīnāṃ nāsti vai kramaḥ ||

tadyathā mahāmate āmraphalāni kramaśaḥ pacyante na yugapat evameva mahāmate svacittadṛśyadhārā sattvānāṃ kramaśo
tadyathā mahāmate kumbhakāraḥ kramaśo bhāṇḍāni kurute na yugapat evameva mahāmate tathāgataḥ sattvānāṃ

tadyathā mahāmate darpaṇāntargatāḥ sarvarūpāvabhāsāḥ saṃdṛśyante nirvikalpā yugapat evameva mahāmate svacittadṛśyadhārāṃ
tadyathā mahāmate somādityamaṇḍalaṃ yugapatsarvarūpāvabhāsān kiraṇaiḥ prakāśayati evameva mahāmate tathāgataḥ
tadyathā mahāmate ālayavijñānaṃ svacittadṛśyadehapratiṣṭhābhogaviṣayaṃ yugapadvibhāvayati evameva mahāmate
tadyathā mahāmate dharmatābuddho yugapan niṣyandanirmāṇakiraṇair virājate evameva mahāmate

tatra mahāmate pratyātmāryādhigamaviśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ śrāvakāṇāṃ katamat yaduta
etaddhi mahāmate śrāvakāṇāṃ pratyātmāryādhigamavihārasukhamadhigamya bodhisattvena mahāsattvena nirodhasukhaṃ

tatkasya hetoḥ tīrthakarāṇāṃ mahāmate nityācintyaṃ na hetusvalakṣaṇayuktam |
yasya mahāmate nityācintyaṃ na hetusvalakṣaṇayuktam tatkathakenābhivyajyate nityamacintyamiti nityācintyavādaḥ punarmahāmate
